blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-04 23:00:00', 5), (2, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-05 00:00:00', 7) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [('2025-12-29', '5.00'), ('2026-01-05', '7.00')], 'Sunday belongs to the previous week'

assert rows_on(q, **{'events': "SELECT CAST(user_id AS INT) AS user_id, CAST(event AS STRING) AS event, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM VALUES (1, 'a', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 09:00:00'), (1, 'b', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 09:30:00'), (1, 'c', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 10:00:01') AS events(user_id, event, ts)"}) == [(1, 2, 3)], 'exactly 30 minutes stays in session'

assert rows_on(q, **{'events': "SELECT CAST(user_id AS INT) AS user_id, CAST(event AS STRING) AS event, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM VALUES (1, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 10:00:00'), (1, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-02 10:00:00'), (2, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 23:00:00'), (2, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-03 10:00:00') AS events(user_id, event, ts)"}) == [('2026-01-01', 2, 1, 50.0)], 'two users, one returns'
